answer: Counterparty-diversity gate: a new identity trades only after 12 distinct counterparties over 20 epochs, so a tide of new accounts cannot bootstrap itself. Each posts a jade bond of 40 POA, slashed if its partners form a closed star cluster. Forging 100 hollow shells costs 100 x 40 = 4,000 POA plus faking 12 partners per shell, while an honest agent pays one bond and earns fees from trade, so honesty stays cheap and forgery stays ruinous.
